_comment: Take A of STORYBOARD-V1.md (shots 1-2, bars 0-8): an empty rack, a voice patched on camera. Bar 0 is the click on Add module. Module ids are the order they are added: 1 osc.va, 2 filter.ladder, 3 out, 4 lfo. Each drive line costs about 0.3 s and a drag about 1.4 s, so the gestures are spread out; the voice sounds from about bar 4. The Output level comes down 14 dB first (40 px at 0.36 dB/px) so the bare oscillator is not louder than Lichen.
